mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program ( source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp, is_source_present ) VALUES ( #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{title}, #{organization}, #{summary}, #{categoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{regionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetDescription}, #{applicationPeriodRaw}, #{applicationStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{applicationEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceSortTimestamp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRUE ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId}, title = #{title}, organization = #{organization}, summary = #{summary}, categories = #{categoriesJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, regions = #{regionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target_description = #{targetDescription}, application_period_raw = #{applicationPeriodRaw}, application_start_date = #{applicationStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, application_end_date = #{applicationEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, source_sort_timestamp = #{sourceSortTimestamp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_source_present = TRUE, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE support_program SET is_source_present = FALSE WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND is_source_present = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT source_code, source_program_id, title, organization, summary, categories, regions, target_description, application_period_raw, application_start_date, application_end_date, source_url, source_sort_timestamp FROM support_program WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId} AND is_source_present = TRUE
